text.p: Following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A major organised crime trial is to begin on Wednesday with 12 men from the Ida-Virumaa county facing extortion and murder charges.
- Government ministers spent a total of 511 days abroad last year. Some 150 trips to 34 countries have taken place.
- The government has decided to become a shareholder of the Hiiumaa dairy in order to write off 2.5 million kroons of debts.
- The boarder town of Moisakula in the western Estonia calls for the reopening of the railway line with Parnu, thus maintaining transit flows.
- The government is to decide whether to pay loans made in 1927 by the pre-war republic, worth some 242 million kroons.
- The planned Tallinn-Tartu motorway is expected to increase the price of land of adjacent plots.
